endpoints.any_damage: Any damage among all eligible reports
endpoints.documented_damage: Documented-extent damage among all eligible reports
endpoints.undetermined_damage: M? damage among all eligible reports

common_subset: The same 773 damage-positive airports; full-report endpoints use 43724 eligible reports there, while conditional M? still uses 3096 damaged reports.
expected_count_subset: Each endpoint selects its own airports using E >= 5; these airport sets are not matched.
scope: Geographic outer-test predictions, excluding the evaluated fold when estimating annual coding rates; targets excluded. This differs from retrospective target allocation based on all national years.
dispersion: Unweighted airport mean of z squared. No subtraction or variance-explained interpretation. The common-set and all-available conditional-M? rows are intentionally identical.
